title: Primary Source Commodities
description: Primary-source commodities data for AI agents — EIA, FRED, CFTC, USDA, USGS via x402 on Base.
summary: Primary-source commodities data for AI agents — EIA, FRED, CFTC, USDA, USGS via x402 on Base.
offersHint: Primary-source commodities data for AI agents — EIA, FRED, CFTC, USDA, USGS via x402 on Base. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://api.commodities.sh/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: catalog.list
toolsPreview.description: List every commodity instrument in the catalog with sector, unit, primary source, and freshness metadata. Call this first to discover valid codes before price.latest or inventory.get. Free discovery tool — no payment required.

toolsPreview.name: price.latest
toolsPreview.description: Return the latest cash/fundies observation for one instrument code. Use catalog.list to discover codes such as CL, GC, or ZC. Response follows the shared observation contract with provenance and license tags.

toolsPreview.name: inventory.get
toolsPreview.description: Fetch EIA weekly petroleum inventory levels. Omit series to list all latest inventory points, or pass a series key to get week-over-week change, vs-5y deviation, and a surprise label for that series.

toolsPreview.name: positioning.get
toolsPreview.description: Return the latest CFTC Commitments of Traders managed-money positioning for an instrument code. Includes long, short, net, and week-over-week net change with source URL.

toolsPreview.name: spread.get
toolsPreview.description: Compute a derived spread observation: 3-2-1 crack, soybean crush, WTI-Brent basis, or calendar (calendar requires licensed curve data and may return available=false). Prefer crack/crush/basis for live derived values with formula and inputs.

toolsPreview.name: price.history
toolsPreview.description: Return historical observations for an instrument code (up to 500 points). Use after price.latest when you need a short time series for the same code.

toolsPreview.name: fx.latest
toolsPreview.description: Return the latest FX rate observation for a pair or FRED FX series. Useful alongside commodity prices when converting cash values across currencies.

toolsPreview.name: fundamentals.get
toolsPreview.description: Fetch a fundamentals document: USDA WASDE, crop progress, export sales, or USGS mineral summaries. Choose kind based on the ags/metals question you are answering.

toolsPreview.name: snapshot.get
toolsPreview.description: Build a sector snapshot bundling prices, inventories, spreads, and related fundies for energy, metals, ags, or all sectors. Prefer this over calling many single-observation tools when you need a full sector picture.

toolsPreview.name: calendar.get
toolsPreview.description: List EIA, USDA, and CFTC release calendar entries with cadence, typical Eastern time, and next-hint notes. Free discovery tool — call before scheduling agents around inventory or WASDE prints.

toolsPreview.name: decision.get
toolsPreview.description: Build a deterministic decision pack for energy, metals, ags, or all sectors. Returns method, signals with direction/rationale, an embedded snapshot, and a disclaimer — no ML model, rule-based only.
